purpose: Prevent machine-level equal-objective scatter from being counted as Residual Blindness. Raw signed differences are saved regardless.
clustering: Complete-linkage Euclidean endpoint hierarchy, no selected distance cutoff and no correct-cluster label.
cross_window_pairing: Match model, direction and radius. Both full planned coverage and native status retained. Each window evaluated at its own prespecified endpoint.
qualification: Native flags only, no state filtered. Missing family comparator is NOT_AVAILABLE and not a fabricated zero gain.
